listenings.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to Paris. My name is Antoine, and I am your driver today. The trip to your hotel is about forty minutes, because the street near the river is very busy. Your hotel is in the Marais, and it is a very good area for a family. There is a big park two minutes from the hotel, and there are many small restaurants on the same street. If you are cold, please tell me and I close the window. Sit back, and enjoy the city. Paris is beautiful in October.

Hello, and welcome to your room. This is a short message from the reception. My name is Elodie, and I work here in the afternoon. Breakfast is on the first floor, from seven to ten, every day. There is a small kitchen next to the breakfast room, with water and coffee, and it is open all day. If you need a taxi, please call the reception and we call one for you. The metro station is very near, but the street is busy in the morning, so please walk together with your family. Have a very good first day in Paris.

extra_audio.text: Marc welcomes Thaís and asks about the reservation. Thaís gives her name and says the room is for three people. Marc asks if this is her first trip to Paris. Thaís says the trip is for her family, not for work. Then Thaís asks where the bathroom and the metro station are.
